title: Split PDF – Separate PDF Pages Free, No Upload | OpenAnyDoc
description: Split a PDF into several files in your browser: by page ranges, every few pages, or one file per page in a ZIP. Free, and nothing is uploaded.
heading: Split PDF
subtitle: Split one PDF into several by page ranges, every few pages, or one file per page; nothing is uploaded.
intro: Split a PDF online into separate files without uploading it: type page ranges such as 1-3, 5, cut the PDF every few pages, or save every page as its own PDF. Several files come in one ZIP, named after your PDF and its page numbers, and the pages keep their original quality.

features.title: Private
features.text: Your file is handled by your own browser and never sent to a server, so nobody else sees it.

features.title: Three ways to split
features.text: Type ranges such as 1-3, 5, 8-10, cut every few pages, or make one file per page.

features.title: Works offline
features.text: Once this page has loaded, the tool keeps working without an internet connection.

steps.title: Choose your PDF
steps.text: Click Choose a file, or drop a PDF on the page. Its pages appear as thumbnails.

steps.title: Pick how to split
steps.text: Type page ranges, choose how many pages go in each file, or make one file per page.

steps.title: Split and download
steps.text: Click Split PDF and check the preview. Several files come in one ZIP.

handles: Page ranges: 1-3, 5, 8-10 makes three PDFs; Arabic digits and the Arabic comma work too.
Every N pages: cut a long PDF into equal parts.
One file per page: every page as its own PDF, all in one ZIP.
Long files: a 150-page PDF splits in seconds, with a progress bar.
limits: PDFs that need a password to open can't be split; remove the password first.
Bookmarks and links between pages may not carry over to the new files.
Very large PDFs are limited by your device's memory.

faq.question: Is my file uploaded?
faq.answer: No. Your file is read and changed by your own browser, on your device, and is never sent anywhere. You can check it: open your browser's network panel while you use the tool and you will see no upload.

faq.question: How do I write page ranges?
faq.answer: Separate them with commas: 1-3, 5, 8-10 makes three PDFs, with pages 1 to 3, page 5, and pages 8 to 10.

faq.question: Will the quality change?
faq.answer: No. Pages are copied as they are, so text, pictures and fonts keep their quality and text stays selectable.

faq.question: Can I use a password-protected PDF?
faq.answer: Not yet. A PDF that needs a password to open can't be read here. Remove the password in the app you use to open it, then try again.

faq.question: Is it really free?
faq.answer: Yes. There is no account, no watermark and no limit on how often you use it.
